templates.text: Is $[[x * 10]] \times 10^{[[n]]}$ in standard form? If not, write it correctly.
templates.answer: No: [[x * 10]] is not between 1 and 10. It is $[[x]] \times 10^{[[n + 1]]}$

templates.text: Write these in order, smallest first: $[[a]] \times 10^{[[m]]}$, $[[b]] \times 10^{[[n]]}$, $[[c]] \times 10^{[[k]]}$.
templates.answer: [[a * 10^m < b * 10^n && a * 10^m < c * 10^k|if:first/]][[b * 10^n < a * 10^m && b * 10^n < c * 10^k|if:second/]][[c * 10^k < a * 10^m && c * 10^k < b * 10^n|if:third/]] is smallest; [[a * 10^m > b * 10^n && a * 10^m > c * 10^k|if:first/]][[b * 10^n > a * 10^m && b * 10^n > c * 10^k|if:second/]][[c * 10^k > a * 10^m && c * 10^k > b * 10^n|if:third/]] is largest

templates.subtopic: Compare and order numbers in standard form
templates.source: Y9 Autumn B7 Standard form · S2 Compare and order numbers in standard form
templates.text: Compare $[[a]] \times 10^{-[[m]]}$ and $[[b]] \times 10^{-[[n]]}$. Which is smaller and why?
templates.answer: The [[a / 10^m < b / 10^n|if:first/second]] is smaller: compare the powers of 10 first ($-[[m]]$ and $-[[n]]$)

templates.subtopic: Compare and order numbers in standard form
templates.source: Y9 Autumn B7 Standard form · S2 Compare and order numbers in standard form
templates.text: The masses of three planets are $[[a]] \times 10^{[[m]]}$ kg, $[[b]] \times 10^{[[n]]}$ kg and $[[c]] \times 10^{[[k]]}$ kg. Which is heaviest, and how many times heavier is it than the lightest? Give your answer to 1 significant figure. (3 marks)
templates.answer: The heaviest is the [[a * 10^m > b * 10^n && a * 10^m > c * 10^k|if:first/]][[b * 10^n > a * 10^m && b * 10^n > c * 10^k|if:second/]][[c * 10^k > a * 10^m && c * 10^k > b * 10^n|if:third/]], about [[sf(max(a * 10^m, max(b * 10^n, c * 10^k)) / min(a * 10^m, min(b * 10^n, c * 10^k)), 1)|group]] times heavier than the lightest
